claim_scope: the named public-native synthetic benchmark and frozen DatasetSpec
the public participant-visible fields and three capacity-change targets
the two independent held-out population/observation realizations
the fixed learner, synthetic label provenance, and update budgets below

estimands.finite_support: Unique donor count, duplicate frequency, exact donor-copy fraction, cell coverage, held-out sample-extrema gaps, nearest-donor distance, and source-to-target label discrepancy.
estimands.predictive_utility: RMSE, MAE, and signed bias in kg by arm, held-out population, lift target, horizon, and fitting seed.
estimands.pretraining_incremental_value: Paired RMSE difference for bootstrap pretraining plus public fine-tuning versus PUBLIC_ONLY and COMPUTE_MATCHED_PUBLIC_ONLY.
estimands.pseudo_label_distillation: Pseudo-label-only and pseudo-label-pretraining results are separate secondary analyses; teacher fitting cost is reported separately.
estimands.synthetic_only_learning: SYNTHETIC_ONLY_BOOTSTRAP and SYNTHETIC_ONLY_PSEUDOLABEL versus PUBLIC_ONLY on identical held-out rows.

hard_failures: protocol, frozen evidence, or upstream source hash mismatch
nonfinite public input, target, learner state, or prediction
held-out target or authority-key leakage to learner
artifact hash, rights, or manifest mismatch
failure_and_interpretation.inconclusive: Sparse support, failed fits, or paired intervals crossing a practical decision boundary remain INCONCLUSIVE. Do not change hyperparameters or margins after inspecting results.
failure_and_interpretation.method_failure: Retain a model-specific failure row and continue other frozen arms; do not substitute a different model.
prohibited_claims: universal failure or success of synthetic pretraining

hypotheses: H1: A fixed learner trained only on donor-copy bootstrap rows may learn predictive structure but receives no independent source-world information beyond its finite public donors.

H2: Bootstrap pretraining followed by the same public fitting rows may change prediction relative to public-only training at equal public-label exposure; any change is an optimization or initialization effect unless it also resolves against compute-matched public-only training.

H3: Pretraining plus public fine-tuning is load-bearing for this learner and realization only if its paired RMSE improvement over compute-matched public-only exceeds the predeclared 1.0 kg practical margin.
H4: Cross-fitted Summary Ridge pseudo-labels may distill a public conditional predictor but are not independent labels from the generating distribution.
H5: Finite donor support, duplicate frequency, and source-target discrepancy can limit synthetic transfer even when the held-out rows follow the same source distribution.

learner.architecture: One linear layer from 58 participant-visible features to 3 target outputs, with bias; 177 trainable scalars.
learner.development: Prediction-only learning curves at 0, 32, 64, 96, and 128 phase updates; compute-matched public-only also at 160, 192, 224, and 256. No dev-based selection or stopping.
learner.initialization: Independent NumPy PCG64 normal weights with mean 0 and standard deviation 0.01 per fit seed; zero biases. Paired arms for each seed start from identical weights.
learner.optimizer: Full-batch gradient calculation on mini-batches sampled with replacement; mean squared error plus 0.5*1e-4 times the squared non-bias weight norm, giving gradient contribution 1e-4*weight.
learner.public_exposure_control: PUBLIC_ONLY and each fine-tuning phase use identical 128 seeded public mini-batches per fitting seed. COMPUTE_MATCHED_PUBLIC_ONLY uses those same first 128 public batches plus 128 further public updates.

participant_schema.feature_map: The RES-290 58-feature Summary Ridge map: latest, mean, and weekly trend for three channels per lift; mean, standard deviation, latest, and weekly trend for dose and intensity per lift; four plan indicators and three horizon indicators. No IDs are features.
forbidden_learner_information: hidden states, population coordinates, or source parameters
authority-only donor, split, or entity matching keys
participant_schema.history: 32 ordered weekly observations at days 6, 13, ..., 223 for squat, bench_press, and deadlift; assessment kg, prescribed load kg, velocity m/s, and public history schedule

protocol.research_question: Does donor-copy or surrogate-pseudo-label pretraining improve prediction on new held-out rows from the same public-native synthetic distribution beyond equal-public-label and equal-compute public-only controls?

roles.evaluation_authority: Generates new public-native rows and truth, constructs donor-copy and cross-fitted pseudo-label records, retains authority keys, runs firewall checks, seals learner predictions before joining held-out truth, and computes evaluation artifacts.
roles.learner: Receives only the arm-specific labeled fitting records and unlabeled development/test participant inputs. It has no generator or evaluation imports, target truth, authority keys, or network/filesystem access.

splits.disjointness: Fitting, development, test A, and test B are generated from independent population, intervention, observation, and split seeds and have distinct opaque entity IDs.
splits.strata: Balanced 4 declared plans by 3 horizons; each split size is divisible by 12.
splits.test_sets: test_population_a and test_population_b are separate source-population and observation draws; both are reported independently.
splits.unit: one public forecast row with a unique entity; all three lift targets share that entity

synthetic_data.bootstrap_duplicate_label: Copy the donor's ORIGINAL_PUBLIC_LABEL together with the full donor row; classify every copied target as BOOTSTRAP_DUPLICATE_LABEL.
synthetic_data.donor_bootstrap: Sample 384 complete public fitting records with replacement, separately within each plan-by-horizon cell, preserving each donor input and its original target. Mint a new opaque row ID and record donor lineage outside learner payloads.
synthetic_data.novel_generation: No genuinely novel synthetic participant records or independently generated source-truth labels are produced. M2 equations remain authority-only.
synthetic_data.surrogate_pseudo_label: Within each of 12 plan-by-horizon cells, use PCG64 seed 292190 to permute the donor IDs and assign four folds round-robin in permuted order. Fit Summary Ridge alpha=100 on the other three folds and predict each held-out donor input; resample complete donor inputs with replacement and copy these teacher predictions. Classify every label as SURROGATE_PSEUDO_LABEL. The donor's own target is excluded from its teacher fit.

uncertainty.decision: Paired delta treatment minus control: resolved benefit if the full interval is below -1 kg; resolved harm if the full interval is above +1 kg; practical equivalence if the full interval lies within [-1,+1] kg; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
uncertainty.pooled_rule: Resample fitting seeds first, then held-out entities within each plan/horizon cell; retain paired arm predictions for each selected entity.
uncertainty.resampling_unit: held-out entity, paired across arms and stratified by plan within each horizon
